summaryZh: Huang Lab 开发基因组与蛋白质组技术，追求单细胞及生物临床样本中 DNA、RNA 和蛋白分子的高准确测序与单分子计数。研究结合表面和聚合物化学、有机合成及光学与流体器件测量。
researchQuestions: 如何实现 DNA、RNA 和蛋白分子的高准确测序与单分子数字计数？
topics: 基因组与蛋白质组技术

evidence.quote: Huang Lab @ UCSD Bioengineering Digital Molecular Biotechnology and Nanodevice Engineering

The mission of our research is to develop the genomic and proteomic technologies that will enable the ultraaccurate sequencing and digital counting of DNA/genomes, RNA and protein molecules in single cells or any biological/clinical samples with single-molecule sensitivity.
Chemistry - Surface and Polymer Chemistry We utilize various approaches to derivatize, modify, conjugate, enhance, and/or passivate surfaces, biomolecules, microbeads, and nanoparticles.
We design and synthesize (by both liquid and solid-phase organic synthesis) photocleavable and chemically cleavable nucleotides for DNA sequencing applications
We develop new optical methods and fluidic devices for measuring the kinetics of enzymatic reactions.
